nodes.label: Claude CLAUDE.md Integration
nodes.rationale: graphify claude install. Writes ## graphify section to CLAUDE.md making graphify always-on in Claude Code sessions.

nodes.label: Graphify Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Turns any folder of files into a navigable knowledge graph with community detection, audit trail, and three outputs: HTML viz, GraphRAG JSON, and GRAPH_REPORT.md.

nodes.label: Hallmark Skill
nodes.rationale: UI design system skill located at skills/hallmark/SKILL.md. Must be consulted before implementing any UI to avoid generic AI-generated patterns.

nodes.label: Hook Install
nodes.rationale: graphify hook install. Post-commit hook auto-rebuilds graph on code changes. No background process needed.

nodes.label: Project Stack
nodes.rationale: Next.js + React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS. All UI work must respect this stack.

nodes.label: Design Philosophy
nodes.rationale: Every visual decision should have a purpose. Avoid generic AI-generated UI. No random gradients, excessive rounded cards, excessive shadows, unnecessary glassmorphism, or decorative animations.

nodes.label: Next.js Breaking Changes
nodes.rationale: This version of Next.js has breaking changes. APIs, conventions, and file structure may differ from training data. Must read docs in node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code.

nodes.label: Community Detection
nodes.rationale: Step 4. Uses Louvain clustering via graspologic (or NetworkX fallback) to partition graph into communities. Surfaces cross-document connections.

nodes.label: Community Labeling
nodes.rationale: Step 5. Agent assigns 2-5 word plain-language names to each community cluster based on node labels.

nodes.label: Cost Tracking
nodes.rationale: Step 9 tracks cumulative token costs in graphify-out/cost.json. Shows per-run and all-time totals.

nodes.label: Extraction Cache
nodes.rationale: Caches semantic extraction results keyed by file + prompt hash. Re-extracts when prompt changes (graphify upgrade). Step B0 checks before dispatching.

nodes.label: God Nodes
nodes.rationale: Highly connected nodes that bridge multiple communities. Identified by degree centrality analysis. Surface the most important entities in the corpus.

nodes.label: GRAPH_REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: Step 5 output. Plain-language audit report with god nodes, surprising connections, and suggested questions.

nodes.label: HTML Visualization
nodes.rationale: Step 6 output. Interactive HTML graph. Auto-aggregates to community view if graph exceeds 5000 nodes.

nodes.label: Shrink Guard
nodes.rationale: Refuses to write graph.json if new graph has fewer nodes than existing. Prevents accidental data loss (#479). Override with --force.

nodes.label: Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Never invent edges, never skip corpus check, always show token cost, never hide cohesion scores, never run HTML viz >5000 nodes without warning.

nodes.label: AST Extraction
nodes.rationale: Part A of Step 3. Deterministic, free, no LLM. Extracts code structure from code files via Python AST. Runs in parallel with semantic extraction.

nodes.label: File Detection
nodes.rationale: Step 1 of pipeline. Classifies files into code, document, paper, image, video categories using graphify.detect module.

nodes.label: Extraction Merge
nodes.rationale: Part C of Step 3. Merges AST extraction (code) and semantic extraction (docs/papers/images) into unified .graphify_extract.json.

nodes.label: Semantic Extraction
nodes.rationale: Part B of Step 3. LLM-based extraction for docs, papers, images. Uses Gemini if API key set, otherwise host agent. Dispatches parallel subagents.

nodes.label: Video/Audio Transcription
nodes.rationale: Step 2.5. Uses Whisper to transcribe video/audio to text. Domain hint from god nodes improves accuracy. Transcripts treated as docs.

nodes.label: Confidence Rubric
nodes.rationale: EXTRACTED=1.0, INFERRED=0.55-0.95 (binned), AMBIGUOUS=0.1-0.3. Never use 0.5 as default. Confidence is mandatory on every edge.

nodes.label: Frontmatter Schema
nodes.rationale: If a file has YAML frontmatter, copy source_url, captured_at, author, contributor onto every node from that file.

nodes.label: Hyperedges
nodes.rationale: Group 3+ nodes participating in a shared concept/flow. Max 3 per chunk. Used when pairwise edges don't capture the group relationship.

nodes.label: Node ID Format
nodes.rationale: {full_repo_relative_path_stem}_{entity_name}, all lowercase, only [a-z0-9_]. Must match AST extractor IDs. Never append chunk numbers.

nodes.label: Semantic Similarity Edges
nodes.rationale: INFERRED edges between concepts solving the same problem without structural links. Score 0.6-0.95 reflecting genuine non-obvious similarity.

nodes.label: Structural Extraction
nodes.rationale: For code files: focus on semantic edges AST cannot find (call relationships, shared data, arch patterns). Do not re-extract imports.

nodes.label: Extraction Subagent Prompt
nodes.rationale: The exact prompt template given to each semantic extraction subagent. Defines schema, rules, and output format.

nodes.label: BFS Traversal
nodes.rationale: Default traversal mode. Broad context, nearest neighbors first. Explores all neighbors layer by layer up to depth 3.

nodes.label: Query Expansion
nodes.rationale: Required before traversal. Expands user question against graph vocabulary. No stemming, no synonyms. Picks up to 12 tokens from vocab file.

nodes.label: Explain Node
nodes.rationale: /graphify explain. Shows everything connected to a single node — label, source, type, degree, all connections.

nodes.label: Path Finding
nodes.rationale: /graphify path. Uses NetworkX shortest_path to find shortest path between two named concepts.

nodes.label: Build Merge
nodes.rationale: Uses build_merge() to read graph.json directly without NetworkX round-trip. Preserves edge direction. Handles replace-on-re-extract.

nodes.label: Cluster Only
nodes.rationale: --cluster-only flag. Skips extraction. Re-runs clustering, naming, and report generation on existing graph. Self-contained.

nodes.label: Incremental Update
nodes.rationale: --update flag. Re-extracts only new/changed files. Saves tokens and time. Uses detect_incremental to diff against manifest.

nodes.label: Manifest
nodes.rationale: Step 9 saves manifest via save_manifest(). Only stamps semantic files that actually produced output. Keys relativized to scan root.

nodes.label: FalkorDB Export
nodes.rationale: --falkordb generates OpenCypher file, --falkordb-push pushes to running instance. Graph defaults to 'graphify'.

nodes.label: MCP Server
nodes.rationale: --mcp starts stdio MCP server exposing tools: query_graph, get_node, get_neighbors, get_community, god_nodes, graph_stats, shortest_path.

nodes.label: Neo4j Export
nodes.rationale: --neo4j generates Cypher file, --neo4j-push pushes to running instance. Uses MERGE for idempotency.

nodes.label: Wiki Export
nodes.rationale: --wiki generates index.md + one article per community. Agent-crawlable wiki. Must run before Step 9 cleanup.

nodes.label: Cross-Repo Merge
nodes.rationale: graphify merge-graphs combines multiple graph.json files. Each node carries a 'repo' attribute for origin filtering.

nodes.label: URL Ingestion
nodes.rationale: /graphify add <url>. Fetches URL, auto-detects type (YouTube, Twitter, arXiv, PDF, image, webpage), saves to ./raw.

nodes.label: Watch Mode
nodes.rationale: --watch flag. Background watcher monitors folder, auto-rebuilds graph on file changes. Debounce default 3s.

links.rationale: AST extraction output feeds into Part C merge.
Both are parallel extraction parts of Step 3 (Part A and Part B). AST for code, semantic for docs/papers/images. They merge in Part C.
Community detection produces clusters. Labeling assigns human-readable names to each cluster.
Community detection results are included in the GRAPH_REPORT.md.
Detection classifies files. Code files go to AST extraction.
Detection classifies files. Doc/paper/image files go to semantic extraction.
Detection classifies video files. Videos are transcribed to text before semantic extraction.
God nodes are identified from the graph structure alongside community detection.
Incremental update uses build_merge to reconcile new extraction with existing graph.
Manifest tracks which files have been extracted. detect_incremental diffs against it.
Query expansion must happen before traversal (BFS or DFS).
Semantic extraction output feeds into Part C merge.
Transcripts are treated as doc files in semantic extraction (Step 3B).
